summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes about 14-17 m away on this side.
reasons: Quiet residential street, few parked cars

best_section.where: North kerb mid-block, between the two driveways before the corner

drivers.seclusion: Houses with front gardens 14-17 m from kerb on this side; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street, a few cars parked on both sides; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street with a side street at the east end.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the kerb, but no overnight van convention.

flags: Steep at west end: up to 17% in places, about 2-3% at best section
sun_shade: Street trees and house trees shade from the north; open to afternoon sun.
